title: GEMglClearDepth
description: specify the clear value for the depth buffer

messages.description: depth value used when the depth buffer is cleared

arguments.description: depth value used when the depth buffer is cleared

body: [GEMglClearDepth] calls glClearDepth() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glClearDepth in the OpenGL reference.
